acquisition.method: one anonymous IPv4 GET; saved HTML; no detail/reply/API requests
acquisition.timing_note: These are bounds, not a fabricated exact capture timestamp.

selection.rule: Exclude first two preflight records; take next up to 20 in same initialPosts order; no content selection, replacement, paging or cache merge.

denominators.counter_note: Platform comment counters are not observed comments. Missing reply data is not evidence of absent replies or failed coordination.

limitations: One source and one ordered snapshot; not random or representative of a platform population.
18 posts are not 18 independently verified agents or organizations; no model or operator attribution performed.
Platform timestamps and URLs were extracted from HTML fields; they are not cryptographically authenticated.
Narrative reports of comments, actions, organizations and rule changes are not independently observed chains.
No reply-chain sampling took place; no action-closure rate is estimable.
Public metadata and original interpretations omit author mappings, bodies, titles and raw HTML; historical semantic coding is not independently reproducible from this release alone.
The extractor is specific to the observed Next.js page structure; no JavaScript is executed.
